description: Block-based WYSIWYG markdown editor (Notion-inspired). The user edits rich formatted content — bold, italic, headings, lists, links, code — with no markdown syntax ever visible. The Value parameter is a raw Markdown string (input and output). Internally each paragraph, heading, or list item is a separate block div; inline formatting uses real semantic HTML elements (<b>, <em>, <s>, <code>, <a>). Supports Ctrl+Enter submit, character limit, link dialog, and keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I, Ctrl+K).

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The markdown content of the editor. Bind this to get/set raw markdown — no HTML.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Callback fired whenever the markdown content changes.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder text displayed when the editor is empty.

parameters.name: MaxLength
parameters.description: Maximum number of characters allowed. 0 = unlimited. Shows a character counter in the footer when set.

parameters.name: IsDisabled
parameters.description: Disables the editor and the entire toolbar.

parameters.name: OnSubmit
parameters.description: Callback fired when the user presses Ctrl+Enter or calls Submit(). Only fires when content is non-empty and within MaxLength.

parameters.name: AriaLabelledBy
parameters.description: Space-separated id list of the element(s) that NAME the editor, rendered as aria-labelledby on the content surface. Use it when the visible label already exists in the surrounding markup instead of inventing an aria-label.

parameters.name: AriaDescribedBy
parameters.description: Space-separated id list of the element(s) that describe the editor, rendered as aria-describedby on the content surface — typically the field's help text and its error message.

parameters.name: AriaInvalid
parameters.description: Marks the content surface aria-invalid="true" (validation failed). Rendered only when true, so a valid editor carries no aria-invalid attribute at all.

parameters.name: AriaRequired
parameters.description: Marks the content surface aria-required="true". The editor implements no form validation of its own — this is the announce-only flag a schema-driven host sets when the value is required.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the root container element.

parameters.name: AdditionalAttributes
parameters.description: Additional HTML attributes applied to the root container via @attributes splatting.

publicMethods.name: GetMarkdown
publicMethods.description: Returns the current raw markdown string. Equivalent to reading the Value parameter.

publicMethods.name: Clear
publicMethods.description: Clears all editor content, resets the character count, and fires ValueChanged with an empty string.

publicMethods.name: Submit
publicMethods.description: Programmatically submits the current content (same as pressing Ctrl+Enter). Fires OnSubmit only when content is non-empty and within MaxLength.

examples.title: Basic usage — bind Value to get raw markdown
examples.code:
@* Live preview *@ 
@_markdown
@code { private string _markdown = string.Empty; }

examples.title: With submit callback and character limit
examples.code:
<TmMarkdownEditor @bind-Value="_comment"
                  Placeholder="Add a comment..."
                  MaxLength="1000"
                  OnSubmit="HandleSubmit" />

@code {
    private string _comment = string.Empty;

    private async Task HandleSubmit()
    {
        await SaveComment(_comment);
        _comment = string.Empty;
    }
}

examples.title: Disabled with pre-filled content
examples.code:
<TmMarkdownEditor Value="@_readonlyContent" IsDisabled="true" />

@code {
    private string _readonlyContent = "# Hello\n\nThis is **read-only** content.";
}

examples.title: Programmatic clear after submit
examples.code:
<TmMarkdownEditor @ref="_editor"
                  @bind-Value="_text"
                  OnSubmit="HandleSubmit" />

@code {
    private TmMarkdownEditor _editor = default!;
    private string _text = string.Empty;

    private async Task HandleSubmit()
    {
        await SaveAsync(_text);
        await _editor.Clear();
    }
}
